_comment: Price list for the `money` subcommand. Units: USD per 1,000,000 tokens. NOT vendored from any pricing page — snapshot it yourself with `opencode models <provider> --verbose` and read cost.input / cost.output / cost.cache.read / cost.cache.write off each model entry. These numbers drift (new model versions, provider repricing); re-run that command and update this file rather than trusting it's still current.
